title: Trust-list presence is the DSC validity check
description: Restates HCERT Specification, 5.1 Simplified SCA/DSC. HCERT Specification, 5.1 Simplified SCA/DSC: “the primary validity mechanism is the presence of the certificate on the most recent version of that certificate list.”.

statements.label: Trust-list presence is the DSC validity check
statements.requirement: The verifier SHALL NOT need CRL or OCSP access. A DSC is valid if it is on the current trust list. The verifier SHOULD also check the DSC's X.509 validity period against the injected clock.
